Malaysian Pilot Arrested in Indonesia for Drug Smuggling

A Malaysian pilot was arrested in Indonesia for attempting to smuggle 70,000 ecstasy pills. He tested positive for meth and cocaine following his apprehension. The pilot faces the death penalty under Indonesian law for drug smuggling offenses.
